summary: Remove the bare-invocation help probe from the eight novel commands so they render results instead of help.
reason: The novel-command scaffold returns cmd.Help() when there are no args and no flags. None of these eight commands takes required input, so a bare invocation printed help while the same command with --json returned real data. --dry-run still short-circuits and exits 0, so verify probes are unaffected.
validated_outcome: Bare 'tree' and 'bid-check' now emit results; all eight still exit 0 under --dry-run and --help.
